notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.9
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where using the shortcut key "Q" during the tutorial would close the instructional UI, causing the tutorial to become stuck and unable to proceed.
Fixed an issue with incorrect spawn locations for roaming enemies.
Fixed an issue where the content in some pop-up messages might display incorrectly in certain situations.
Fixed an issue on the fifth map where the cost deducted during bribery was higher than the amount shown.
Fixed various error messages.
Added new functions to the in-level menu: on Brutal difficulty, a "Restart" option has been added; on other difficulties, a new option to load the latest save has been added.
Added prompts to the War Workshop button, displaying the number of available devices and their cooldown time.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.8 - Allow attacking invading enemies
notes.notes: Restore the function of attacking invading enemies and fix the pathfinding issue.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.7 - Minor changes
notes.notes:
The function of actively attacking invading troops has been canceled due to potential errors in pathfinding
Enhance the display of information during troop deployment, accessible via the shortcut key Alt
Record the zooming of battle scenes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.6 - Hotkeys
notes.notes:
Added WASD movement within levels, so building hotkeys have been adjusted from QWER to QERT.
Building hotkeys now toggle the interface on and off, instead of only opening it.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0.5
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where resolution changes wouldn't take effect after restarting
 Buffed the stats of the ballista
 Fixed some animation display errors
 Changed spacebar toggle to restore the previous speed when switching

notes.title: Officially released on July 19! Rich game content, 20% off for the first release
notes.notes:
Dear players, our game is finally going to be released! 20% off for the first release!

In the official version, you will experience:

15 types of soldiers with different abilities:
Farmer, Hunter, Blacksmith, Woodcutter, Iron Head, Swordsman, Assassin, Guard, Archer, Knight, Giant Swordsman, Royal Archer, Butcher, Executioner, Life Slayer.

5 completely different gameplay mechanisms:
A New Beginning: Start from scratch and take root in this wasteland with wisdom and courage.
Plague Land: Diseases are sweeping, troops are in danger, and you need to seize the antidote from powerful enemies.
Bandit Forest: Fight wits and courage with greedy bandits, and make careful decisions in the face of extortion.
Desolate Land: Resources are scarce, should you trade or fight? Those who survive will become stronger.
Under the Imperial City: Victory never belongs to the most powerful party, but to the party that can manipulate people's hearts the most.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318205/67287ec82dea066c9f368eafccefa666d8879dfe.jpg

I hope you like our game. If you think it's good, I hope you can recommend it to your friends, thank you!

Kingdom Ascension Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.4 - Formation Save
notes.notes:
We have added a new feature that automatically saves your last deployed formation. It will be preloaded the next time you enter battle.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0.3 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed some text errors

Fixed the issue where the close button was obscured
[/olist]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0.2 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed an issue where the tutorial could not be completed properly

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 - Remove The Day Limit For Demo
notes.notes:
Added a tutorial level.
 Removed the day limit in the demo level.
 Adjusted the sound effects.
 Reduce the recruitment requirements of advanced soldiers.
 Due to code refactoring, previous saves are not compatible.
 Some other balance adjustments, along with some bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.5.0 - Balance Adjustments
notes.notes:
Unit costs halved.
 Enemy numbers increased by 1.5 times.
 Due to difficulty adjustments, save files from previous versions are no longer compatible.
 Some other balance adjustments, along with some bug fixes.
 Added a feature to automatically save the zoom level before the end of a battle, eliminating the need to adjust it every time.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.4.1 - Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Added a feature to view the full list of availible buildings.
 Fixed bugs where some UI elements caused interaction issues.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.4 - Changes & Balance Adjustments
notes.notes:
Adjusted difficulty: increased early-game difficulty while keeping late-game difficulty unchanged.
 Tweaked unit stats and added a slight extra resistance to ranged attacks for advanced units.
 Unit detailed stats are now displayed.
 Casual mode now available.
 Fix some known issues.
 Due to difficulty adjustments, save files from previous versions are no longer compatible.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.3.9 - Quick Bug & Turkish language Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where Turkish translations were not loading correctly.
 Fixed an issue where attacking sentry post was not possible in version 0.2.3.8.
 Fixed a potential loading issue that could occur after battles ended.
 Fixed several other known issues.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.3.7 - Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
What's Changed:

 Add the functionality for occupied outposts to serve as troop deployment points.
 Add a feature in settings to clear data.
 Adjust the default order of troop formations.


What's Fixed:

 Fix the issue where some players could not save or load their progress.
 Fix the issue where certain items were not consumed upon use.
 Fix the issue where troops could not return to the base.
 Fix some known issues.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.3.5 - Quick Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for trying out the demo version! We've received a lot of feedback about bugs and have already fixed some urgent issues. If you encounter any bugs or experience issues, please continue to share them with us. We truly appreciate your support and participation!

What's Fixed:

 Fixed an issue where data could not be properly loaded when switching scenes.
 Fixed an issue where the construction UI could not be closed properly.
 Fixed several other minor issues.
